events.title: Former 배로 defender James Cotterill is sentenced to four months in prison for causing grievous bodily harm to 브리스틀 로버스 player Sean Rigg during an FA Cup first round match in November 2006. Rigg suffered a double fracture of the jaw after being punched by Cotterill.

In the FA Cup third round replays, third tier 브리스틀 시티 knock out Championship club 코번트리 시티 . Elsewhere, top-flight sides 맨체스터 시티 and 미들즈브러 survive scares against Football League teams to progress, beating 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 헐 시티 respectively.
Peter Taylor resigns as England under-21 manager, stating that he wants to focus on managing his other team, 크리스털 팰리스 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the Premiership and look safe to reclaim the title they last won in 2003. 첼시 remain six points behind, with 리버풀, 아스널, Bolton, 포츠머스 and Reading (the latter expected by many to struggle in their first ever top-flight campaign) completing the top seven. The relegation zone remains unchanged from the end of December, but the strugglers are cranking up the pressure on 위건 애슬레틱. 더비 카운티 end the month as the leader of the Championship, six points clear of Birmingham (who have two games in hand) and Preston, with 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 사우샘프턴 and a resurgent Cardiff not far behind. Leeds has swapped places with Southend at the foot of the Championship while Hull have escaped the bottom three at the expense of QPR.
